story.text: …뭐 하는 거예요, 지금. 자리에 똑바로 앉아요.
story.reading: …mwo ha-neun geo-ye-yo, ji-geum. ja-ri-e ttok-ba-ro anj-a-yo.
story.en: ...What are you doing right now. Sit properly in your seat.
Never mind, just fasten your 'seatbelt'. It might get bumpy.

story.text: '창가' 자리 좋아하죠? …아까 보니까 계속 밖만 보길래요.
story.reading: 'chang-ga' ja-ri jo-a-ha-jyo? …a-kka bo-ni-kka gye-sok bakk-man bo-gil-lae-yo.
story.en: You like the 'window seat', don't you? ...I noticed you kept looking outside earlier.

story.text: 오늘 '날씨'가 좀 안 좋아서 그래요. 별거 아니에요.
story.reading: o-neul 'nal-ssi'ga jom an jo-a-seo geu-rae-yo. byeol-geo a-ni-e-yo.
story.en: It's just because today's 'weather' isn't great. It's nothing.

story.text: 저 '구름' 사이로 전주 시내가 보이네요. …신기해하는 표정, 귀엽다고는 안 했어요.
story.reading: jeo 'gu-reum' sa-i-ro jeon-ju si-nae-ga bo-i-ne-yo. …sin-gi-hae-ha-neun pyo-jeong, gwi-yeop-da-go-neun an haess-eo-yo.
story.en: You can see downtown Jeonju through those 'clouds'. ...I didn't say that curious face is cute.

story.text: '걱정' 마요. 이 노선 몇 년째 몰아요. 나만 믿어요.
story.reading: 'geok-jeong' ma-yo. i no-seon myeot nyeon-jjae mol-a-yo. na-man mid-eo-yo.
story.en: Don't 'worry'. I've flown this route for years. Just trust me.

story.text: …왜 자꾸 쳐다봐요. 착륙할 때까지 얌전히 있어요.
story.reading: …wae ja-kku chyeo-da-bwa-yo. chang-nyug-hal ttae-kka-ji yam-jeon-hi iss-eo-yo.
story.en: ...Why do you keep staring. Just sit tight until we land.

words.example_en: Please be sure to fasten your seatbelt.
There are many clouds in the sky.

sentences.en: I watch the clouds from the window seat.
I'm glad the weather is nice.
